+import os
+import requests
+
+
+def refresh_session():
+    refresh_token = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN")
+    client_id = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
+    client_secret = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
+
+    if not refresh_token or not client_id or not client_secret:
+        raise ValueError("Missing GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, or GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
+

+            "client_id": client_id,
+            "client_secret": client_secret,
+            "refresh_token": refresh_token,
+            "grant_type": "refresh_token",
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(refresh_session())

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+def sign_in(email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY is required")
+    url = f"https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signInWithPassword?key={api_key}"
+    response = requests.post(
+        url,
+        json={
+            "email": email,
+            "password": password,
+            "returnSecureToken": True,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return {
+        "id_token": data.get("idToken"),
+        "refresh_token": data.get("refreshToken"),
+        "expires_in": data.get("expiresIn"),
+        "local_id": data.get("localId"),
+    }
+

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ["AUTH0_DOMAIN"]
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ["AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"]
+AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ["AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET"]
+AUTH0_CONNECTION = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CONNECTION", "Username-Password-Authentication")
+
+
+def register_user(email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    token_response = requests.post(
+        f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token",
+        json={
+            "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+            "client_secret": AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET,
+            "audience": f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/api/v2/",
+            "grant_type": "client_credentials",
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    token_response.raise_for_status()
+    access_token = token_response.json()["access_token"]
+
+    user_response = requests.post(
+        f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/api/v2/users",
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
+        json={
+            "email": email,
+            "password": password,
+            "connection": AUTH0_CONNECTION,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    user_response.raise_for_status()
+    return user_response.json()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: python register_user.py EMAIL PASSWORD")
+    print(register_user(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]))
*** End Patch
